'''2009 Bespin Regionals Tom Frafjord LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed)|OVS17-10-We_ll_Handle_This-remaster.webp|label=We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom Fafjord
* '''Deck name:''' Say "What?" One More Time
* '''Username:''' CitizenSwanky
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
